title: Eastern-Style Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and aromatic chicken dish inspired by the Middle East. Marinated in a blend of spices and grilled to perfection, served in a pita with fresh vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together tahini paste, apple cider vinegar, butter, spice blend, salt, and garlic.
Add the chicken to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove chicken from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven at 350°F for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the grilled chicken and serving it in the pita with tomato, parsley, and your favorite toppings.
